# Convergence rollout tail: Phase-3 consumer swap flip + live shadow-pass validation + capped live heal

## Summary
High-risk tail of the convergence rollout, carved from soar-quill-flare (7d23). Per epic adept-hedge-stain the
AGENT (ACLI access) performs the live validation directly, with GUARANTEED cleanup of test artifacts in both live
Jira and the local store (full-surface validation is centralized in sibling D1 close-ferreous-cardinal). The
`.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml` workflow runs `rebar reconcile --mode live` every 20 min.

## What already landed (7d23, on main)
- Phase-1 baseline dual-write SHADOW (`baseline_shadow.py`) behind `reconciler.baseline_dual_write`, with per-pass
  `baseline_shadow_check` logging + `baseline_shadow_divergence` alert.
- Circuit breaker (`check_blast_radius`, default 0.10) before the first acting mutation.

## Remaining CODE
- [CODE] Phase-3 consumer swap: re-point `outbound_fields._local_matches_prev` (and its `outbound_differ` caller)
  from `prev_snapshot` to `BindingStore.get_baseline`, behind a NEW flag `reconciler.baseline_consumer_swap`
  (bool, default false; add to `ReconcilerConfig` in `_config_schema.py`, distinct from `baseline_dual_write`).
  PRESERVE byte-for-byte: absent-baseline->local-wins; corrupt-store fail-closed abort. NOTE `get_baseline` returns
  None for a non-dict/absent entry, so map None -> the existing absent-baseline (local-wins) branch, and add an
  explicit corrupt-store detection (get_baseline cannot itself signal "corrupt") so fail-closed is preserved.
  Document the flag + flip procedure in `docs/jira-sync-setup.md`.
- [CODE] RED-first direction-preservation property test running the SWAPPED consumer, covering the five mirrored
  fields as MAPPED (local title/description/priority/status/assignee <-> Jira summary/description/priority/status/
  assignee — reconcile the two field-name sets `_INBOUND_MIRRORED_FIELDS` and `baseline_shadow._MIRRORED_FIELDS`);
  name it distinctly from the existing `test_property_direction_preservation`.
- [CODE] Census key: expand-contract — emit BOTH `decision_census` and `binding_walk_census` for one release,
  migrate consumers to `decision_census`, then drop `binding_walk_census`. (Not a bare rename.)
- [CODE] classifier-vs-legacy divergence alerting: compare `classify()`'s per-binding decision against the
  PRODUCTION differ's action for that binding in the SAME pass, emitting `classifier_legacy_divergence`
  {classifier_count:int, legacy_count:int, divergent_pairs:list[str] of local_ids, pass_id:str}. If a per-binding
  production decision is not extractable for a given code path, scope the alert to the paths where it is and
  document the gap (do NOT invent a parallel legacy engine).

## Remaining OPERATIONAL (agent-run with ACLI; guaranteed cleanup)
- [OPERATIONAL] >=10 CONSECUTIVE clean shadow passes (`baseline_shadow_check` divergent==0) BEFORE flipping the flag.
  Streak is DERIVED from the sync-log history (query the last N `baseline_shadow_check` events), NOT an in-memory
  counter, so a fresh GHA process recomputes it; any divergent>0 OR a >20-min gap resets it and emits
  `baseline_shadow_divergence`. COORDINATION: A3's live remediation pauses the reconciler and will reset this streak
  — do NOT run A3's live pass during the streak window (sequence them).
- [OPERATIONAL] Capped live heal under bootstrap-strict incl. the GC-after-grace deletion (f8b5-2f30 -> REB-530).
  PRE-HEAL BACKUP covers BOTH sides: export affected Jira issue state (JSON via Jira API) AND tag the tickets branch
  (`git tag pre-heal-<date>`) so binding-store mutations are recoverable; if either backup fails, ABORT the heal.
  Store the artifacts in the workflow run artifacts (retention documented).
- [OPERATIONAL] Flip the flag only after BOTH gates. Rollback rehearsed: (a) revert the flag to false and confirm
  the reconciler reverts to `prev_snapshot` arbitration with no divergence, AND (b) force one `--mode dry-run` pass
  confirming zero mutations; record both workflow run-ids.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] [CODE] `reconciler.baseline_consumer_swap` flag added + documented in `docs/jira-sync-setup.md`; `_local_matches_prev` reads `get_baseline` behind it; None->local-wins; corrupt-store fail-closed preserved (explicit detection).
- [ ] [CODE] RED-first direction-preservation property test (swapped consumer, five mapped fields) RED before, GREEN after.
- [ ] [CODE] Census emits both keys (expand-contract), consumers migrated to `decision_census`; `classifier_legacy_divergence` emitted with the typed fields above (or scoped+documented where per-binding legacy decisions aren't extractable).
- [ ] [OPERATIONAL] >=10 consecutive clean shadow passes (log-derived streak, reset rule above) before the flip, NOT overlapping A3's live pass; evidence recorded.
- [ ] [OPERATIONAL] Capped live heal with a bilateral pre-heal backup (Jira JSON + tickets-branch tag); heal aborts if either backup fails; artifacts stored.
- [ ] [OPERATIONAL] Flip only after both gates; rollback rehearsed (flag-revert + dry-run run-ids recorded).
